runtime_evidence_contract.durability: The supervisor-owned controller persists stream evidence, state, health projection, gap observations, and reports through the existing repository/archive path.

classifications.transport_received: A frame arrived and passed basic capture identity/size/hash validation.
classifications.source_current: As-of feed freshness and source-health checks pass for that source/epoch; this says nothing about missed history.
classifications.sequence_valid: Local order-book translator and snapshot/reset rules are currently satisfied. This does not create an unpublished Bybit venue guarantee.
classifications.observed_trade_evidence: One or more individual trade observations arrived and were durably archived/indexed.
classifications.trade_completeness_proven: Always false for this Bybit public-trade source because no historical cursor or gap repair is declared.
classifications.strategy_input_qualified: Always false in S32; policy-specific cadence, warmup, coverage and evidence gates are not granted by this report.

feed_capabilities.transport_received: Evidence may be true for an actual captured frame.
feed_capabilities.source_current: Evidence may be true only for a fresh matching source-health/recovery epoch.
feed_capabilities.sequence_semantics: BYBIT_U update ID; seq is retained as cross-sequence. Existing translator fails closed on nonconsecutive u and u=1 reset.
feed_capabilities.sequence_valid: Only when the existing local snapshot/delta state is valid for the same full instrument and metadata revision at the report cutoff.
feed_capabilities.latest_bbo: Reported only from a valid fresh SequenceValidBookV2 feature; cold, stale, reset, or mismatched state gives null with a reason.
feed_capabilities.disconnect_restart_recovery: Invalidate local book and require a new snapshot/sequence state. S32 does not claim a REST snapshot bridge.
feed_capabilities.venue_continuity_guarantee: Not published/verified; no strong guarantee inferred.
